about: Crawl actions a person has checked and found correct. The nightly crawl only fails on suspicious actions NOT listed here. An entry matches one site (registrable domain) and one exact action; a different action on the same site is treated as new. Copy the action text from the report's 'acted:' column (without the trailing '(top)' / '(iframe)').
